snippet.title: Mirthwood - Co-Op Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Venture into the Freelands of Mirthwood, where you can choose your fate with a friend at your side for the first time. Experience synchronous drop-in/drop-out local co-op and a dynamic shared screen for seamless collaboration. Retain your levels, skills, and inventories when switching between co-op and single-player modes. All features you’ve encountered on your adventures can now be enjoyed with company, including marriage and starting a family.

Start life’s greatest journey in Mirthwood on Steam today: 
https://bit.ly/Mirthwood_on_Steam_YT

Find Mirthwood on:
Twitter: https://x.com/MirthwoodGame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mirthwoodgame/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MirthwoodGame/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/w9RWr2MNFg
